description:
This protocol automates sample plating from collection tubes to a 96-well plate. After sample plating (Station A), the plate containing samples can be used on Station B for RNA extraction as outlined in our article on automating Covid-19 testing.

Using a Single-Channel Pipette, this protocol will transfer the user-specified volume from sample tubes placed in the Opentrons Tube Rack into a 96-well plate. Users can specify which pipette, the type of source tube, the type of destination plate, the number of samples to transfer, and the volume of each sample being transferred.

If you have any questions about this protocol, please email our Applications Engineering team at protocols@opentrons.com.


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.19.0 or later)
Opentrons Single-Channel Pipette
Opentrons Filter Tips
Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack Set
96-Well Plate
Sample Tubes



The Opentrons tiprack should be placed in slot 3 and the 96-well plate should be placed in slot 2.
With this protocol, the Opentrons tube rack with samples will be accessed in the following order: slot 1, 4, 7, 10, 5, 8, 11 -- see below for examples.

Using the customizations field (below), set up your protocol.
 Number of Samples: Specify the number of samples to run (1-96)
 Volume of Samples (in µL): Specify the volume to be transferred from sample tubes to destination plate (this volume should fall in the range of the selected pipette)
 Destination Plate Labware: Specify whether to use the NEST Deepwell Plate, 2mL or the NEST PCR Plate as the destination plate
 Source Tube Labware: Specify whether to use the Opentrons Tubebrack (24) with 2mL, 1.5mL, or 0.5mL tubes or the Opentrons Tuberack (15) with 15mL conical tubes.
* Pipette Type: Specify which pipette (p300/p1000 GEN1/GEN2) to use (should be mounted on the right gantry)
